spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m3p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, Capacity
None == "none"
VARIABLES leader, booked, standby, stepping
vars == <<leader, booked, standby, stepping>>

Total == booked["x"] + booked["y"]

TypeState ==
    /\ leader \in [Instances -> {"p", "q", None}]
    /\ booked \in [Instances -> 0..Capacity]
    /\ standby \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ stepping \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ leader = [i \in Instances |-> None]
    /\ booked = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ standby = [i \in Instances |-> TRUE]
    /\ stepping = [i \in Instances |-> FALSE]

Elect(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] = None
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = "p"]
    /\ standby' = [standby EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, stepping>>

Failover(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] = "p"
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = "q"]
    /\ stepping' = [stepping EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, standby>>

Book(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # None
    /\ Total < Capacity
    /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![i] = booked[i] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, standby, stepping>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ booked[i] > 0
    /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![i] = booked[i] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, standby, stepping>>

Next == \E i \in Instances : Elect(i) \/ Failover(i) \/ Book(i) \/ Release(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TheatreCapacity ==
    /\ Total >= 0
    /\ Total <= Capacity
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {"x", "y"}
    Capacity = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TheatreCapacity
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler runs two independent scheduling instances that share one pool of operating rooms. Each instance elects its own coordinator through leader election with failover, and only a current leader may book a room from the shared pool. A booking is allowed only while the total number of rooms booked across both instances is below the shared theatre capacity. A leader may release a room it booked, and leadership can fail over to another node in the same instance after the leader steps down. The safety concern is that the two instances together never book more rooms than the shared theatre capacity provides.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of rooms booked across both instances is always non-negative and never exceeds the shared theatre capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m3p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Flights, Runways
None == "none"
VARIABLES assign, reqs, leader, term
vars == <<assign, reqs, leader, term>>

TypeState ==
    /\ assign \in [Runways -> Flights \cup {None}]
    /\ reqs \subseteq (Flights \X Runways)
    /\ leader \in Flights \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ assign = [r \in Runways |-> None]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0

Elect(f) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term < 2
    /\ leader' = f
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, reqs>>

StepDown ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, reqs, term>>

Request(f, r) ==
    /\ <<f, r>> \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {<<f, r>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, leader, term>>

Grant(f, r) ==
    /\ leader = f
    /\ <<f, r>> \in reqs
    /\ assign[r] = None
    /\ \A rr \in Runways : assign[rr] # f
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![r] = f]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<f, r>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ assign[r] # None
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, leader, term>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Flights : Elect(f)
    \/ StepDown
    \/ \E f \in Flights, r \in Runways : Request(f, r) \/ Grant(f, r)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Release(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RunwayUnique ==
    /\ (\A p, q \in Runways :
            (assign[p] # None /\ assign[p] = assign[q]) => p = q)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Flights = {f1, f2}
    Runways = {r1, r2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayUnique
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator assigns each of two runways to at most one flight, coordinated by a leader-elected controller with failover, over a channel where request messages can be reordered. Flights post allocation requests into a request set that the controller may consume in any order (reordering). Only the current leader may grant a runway, and it grants a runway to a requesting flight only if that runway is currently unassigned. A flight releases its runway when it has departed, and leadership may fail over to a standby after the leader steps down. The safety concern is that a runway is never double-allocated: no runway is assigned to two different flights at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each runway is assigned to at most one flight at any time, and no two runways are assigned to the same flight.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m8p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Trains, MaxGen
None == "none"
VARIABLES inter, block, proceeding, auth, gen
vars == <<inter, block, proceeding, auth, gen>>

TypeState ==
    /\ inter \in Trains \cup {None}
    /\ block \in Trains \cup {None}
    /\ proceeding \in [Trains -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ auth \in [Trains -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen

Init ==
    /\ inter = None
    /\ block = None
    /\ proceeding = [t \in Trains |-> FALSE]
    /\ auth = [t \in Trains |-> 0]
    /\ gen = 0

TakeInter(t) ==
    /\ inter = None
    /\ inter' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<block, proceeding, auth, gen>>

TakeBlock(t) ==
    /\ inter = t
    /\ block = None
    /\ block' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, proceeding, auth, gen>>

Proceed(t) ==
    /\ inter = t
    /\ block = t
    /\ auth[t] = gen
    /\ ~proceeding[t]
    /\ proceeding' = [proceeding EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, block, auth, gen>>

Clear(t) ==
    /\ proceeding[t]
    /\ proceeding' = [proceeding EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, block, auth, gen>>

ReleaseBlock(t) ==
    /\ block = t
    /\ ~proceeding[t]
    /\ block' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, proceeding, auth, gen>>

ReleaseInter(t) ==
    /\ inter = t
    /\ block # t
    /\ inter' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<block, proceeding, auth, gen>>

RequestAuth(t) ==
    /\ auth[t] # gen
    /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![t] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, block, proceeding, gen>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ proceeding' = [t \in Trains |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inter, block, auth>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : TakeInter(t) \/ TakeBlock(t) \/ Proceed(t) \/ Clear(t)
                          \/ ReleaseBlock(t) \/ ReleaseInter(t) \/ RequestAuth(t)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyClearedProceed ==
    /\ (\A t \in Trains : proceeding[t] =>
            (inter = t /\ block = t /\ auth[t] = gen))
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Trains = {t1, t2}
    MaxGen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyClearedProceed
nl:
A subway signalling block system guards each track block with hierarchical locks and per-train movement authority, and the number of blocks in service can be reconfigured at runtime. A train must hold the coarse interlocking lock and then the fine block lock, and must carry a movement authority matching the current signalling generation, before it may proceed into a block. Locks release block-before-interlocking. A train whose authority is stale (behind the current generation) may not proceed until it re-requests authority. The generation advances when the block plan is reconfigured, invalidating old authorities. The safety concern is that no train proceeds without being properly authorized: any proceeding train holds both locks and current movement authority.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a train is proceeding it holds both the interlocking and block locks and its movement authority equals the current signalling generation.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m1p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Techs
None == "none"
VARIABLES tokenAt, inSlot, waiting, phase
vars == <<tokenAt, inSlot, waiting, phase>>

TypeState ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Techs
    /\ inSlot \in Techs \cup {None}
    /\ waiting \in [Techs -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "busy"}

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = "t1"
    /\ inSlot = None
    /\ waiting = [t \in Techs |-> FALSE]
    /\ phase = "idle"

Request(t) ==
    /\ ~waiting[t]
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, inSlot, phase>>

Enter(t) ==
    /\ tokenAt = t
    /\ inSlot = None
    /\ waiting[t]
    /\ inSlot' = t
    /\ phase' = "busy"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, waiting>>

Leave(t) ==
    /\ inSlot = t
    /\ inSlot' = None
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt>>

PassToken ==
    /\ inSlot = None
    /\ tokenAt' = (IF tokenAt = "t1" THEN "t2" ELSE "t1")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inSlot, waiting, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Request(t) \/ Enter(t) \/ Leave(t)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SingleSlotHolder ==
    /\ (inSlot # None => tokenAt = inSlot)
    /\ (inSlot # None => phase = "busy")
    /\ (inSlot = None => phase = "idle")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Techs = {"t1", "t2"}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SingleSlotHolder
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker uses a token ring to grant exclusive access to the single cold-storage write slot so that two technicians never edit the same batch record at once. The write token circulates around the ring; a technician may only enter the slot when the token currently rests at their position and the slot is free, and they release the slot when done. Passing the token to the next position is only allowed while nobody holds the slot. A technician may be slow (delaying before entering or releasing) but is never considered failed, so the token is never forcibly reclaimed. The safety concern is that at most one technician occupies the write slot at any time, and only the token holder can be in it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one technician occupies the write slot at any instant, and whoever occupies it currently holds the ring token.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m8p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, Supply
None == "none"
VARIABLES float, box, route, fine
vars == <<float, box, route, fine>>

Boxed == box["m1"] + box["m2"]

TypeState ==
    /\ float \in 0..Supply
    /\ box \in [Machines -> 0..Supply]
    /\ route \in Machines \cup {None}
    /\ fine \in Machines \cup {None}

Init ==
    /\ float = Supply
    /\ box = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ route = None
    /\ fine = None

TakeRoute(m) ==
    /\ route = None
    /\ route' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, box, fine>>

TakeFine(m) ==
    /\ route = m
    /\ fine = None
    /\ fine' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, box, route>>

MoveOut(m) ==
    /\ fine = m
    /\ float > 0
    /\ float' = float - 1
    /\ box' = [box EXCEPT ![m] = box[m] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<route, fine>>

ReturnIn(m) ==
    /\ fine = m
    /\ box[m] > 0
    /\ box' = [box EXCEPT ![m] = box[m] - 1]
    /\ float' = float + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<route, fine>>

ReleaseFine(m) ==
    /\ fine = m
    /\ fine' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, box, route>>

ReleaseRoute(m) ==
    /\ route = m
    /\ fine # m
    /\ route' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<float, box, fine>>

Next ==
    \E m \in Machines :
        TakeRoute(m) \/ TakeFine(m) \/ MoveOut(m) \/ ReturnIn(m)
        \/ ReleaseFine(m) \/ ReleaseRoute(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CoinConservation ==
    float + Boxed = Supply
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {"m1", "m2"}
    Supply = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CoinConservation
nl:
A vending machine network moves coins between a central float and per-machine cash boxes under hierarchical locks, so that a transfer touches the shared float only while both the coarse route lock and the fine box lock are held. An operator agent takes the route lock, then the box lock, then may move one coin from the float into a machine's box, or return one coin from a box back to the float; locks release box-before-route. An agent may be slow holding a lock but is never failed, so no lock is forcibly reclaimed. Coins are never minted or destroyed: every coin is either in the central float or in exactly one machine's box. The safety concern is conservation of the coin supply.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the coins in the central float plus the coins across all machine boxes always equal the fixed coin supply.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m8p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Agents, MaxGen
None == "none"
VARIABLES region, machine, dispensing, clearance, gen
vars == <<region, machine, dispensing, clearance, gen>>

TypeState ==
    /\ region \in Agents \cup {None}
    /\ machine \in Agents \cup {None}
    /\ dispensing \in [Agents -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ clearance \in [Agents -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen

Init ==
    /\ region = None
    /\ machine = None
    /\ dispensing = [a \in Agents |-> FALSE]
    /\ clearance = [a \in Agents |-> 0]
    /\ gen = 0

TakeRegion(a) ==
    /\ region = None
    /\ region' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED <<machine, dispensing, clearance, gen>>

TakeMachine(a) ==
    /\ region = a
    /\ machine = None
    /\ machine' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, dispensing, clearance, gen>>

Dispense(a) ==
    /\ region = a
    /\ machine = a
    /\ clearance[a] = gen
    /\ ~dispensing[a]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![a] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, machine, clearance, gen>>

Finish(a) ==
    /\ dispensing[a]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, machine, clearance, gen>>

ReleaseMachine(a) ==
    /\ machine = a
    /\ ~dispensing[a]
    /\ machine' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, dispensing, clearance, gen>>

ReleaseRegion(a) ==
    /\ region = a
    /\ machine # a
    /\ region' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<machine, dispensing, clearance, gen>>

Refresh(a) ==
    /\ clearance[a] # gen
    /\ clearance' = [clearance EXCEPT ![a] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, machine, dispensing, gen>>

Reauthorize ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ dispensing' = [a \in Agents |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, machine, clearance>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents : TakeRegion(a) \/ TakeMachine(a) \/ Dispense(a)
                          \/ Finish(a) \/ ReleaseMachine(a) \/ ReleaseRegion(a) \/ Refresh(a)
    \/ Reauthorize

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedDispense ==
    /\ (\A a \in Agents : dispensing[a] =>
            (region = a /\ machine = a /\ clearance[a] = gen))
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Agents = {a1, a2}
    MaxGen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedDispense
nl:
A vending machine network protects each dispense with hierarchical locks: an agent must hold the coarse region lock and then the fine machine lock before it may dispense, and it must also present a clearance stamp matching the network's current authorization generation. Locks are released fine-before-coarse. An agent whose clearance is stale (behind the current generation) is slow but not failed; it simply cannot dispense until it refreshes its clearance to the current generation. The authorization generation can advance, invalidating old clearances. The safety concern is that no dispense is performed by an unauthorized or stale participant: any agent that dispenses holds both locks and carries current clearance.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever an agent is dispensing it holds both the region and machine locks and its clearance equals the current authorization generation.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m9p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Agents, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, committed, proposal, admin
vars == <<epoch, committed, proposal, admin>>

None == "none"

TypeState ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ committed \in 0..5
    /\ proposal \in [Agents -> 0..MaxEpoch \cup {-1}]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ committed = 0
    /\ proposal = [a \in Agents |-> -1]
    /\ admin = FALSE

Propose(a) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ proposal[a] = -1
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![a] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, committed, admin>>

Apply(a) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ proposal[a] = epoch
    /\ committed < 5
    /\ committed' = committed + 1
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![a] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, admin>>

RejectStale(a) ==
    /\ proposal[a] # -1
    /\ proposal[a] # epoch
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![a] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, committed, admin>>

Rotate ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, proposal, admin>>

AdminForce ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ committed < 5
    /\ committed' = committed + 1
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, proposal>>

AdminClear ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, committed, proposal>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Propose(a) \/ Apply(a) \/ RejectStale(a)
    \/ Rotate \/ AdminForce \/ AdminClear

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PriceLogMonotone ==
    /\ committed >= 0
    /\ (\A a \in Agents : proposal[a] # -1 => proposal[a] <= epoch)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Agents = {a1, a2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PriceLogMonotone
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A vending machine network keeps a shared price record replicated per epoch, and only writes tagged with the current epoch may be applied. Field agents propose price updates that carry the epoch they read; an update is accepted and advances the committed price counter only when its epoch matches the current epoch, so stale writes are rejected rather than overwriting fresher data. When the network reconfigures it rotates to a new epoch, invalidating any in-flight stale proposals. A privileged admin override can force a corrected price, which also advances the committed counter and consumes the current epoch's write. The safety concern is that no committed price update is lost: the committed counter never regresses and no stale-epoch write is ever applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the committed price counter never decreases, and it is only ever advanced by a write whose epoch matched the current epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m1p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones
VARIABLES tokenAt, armed, drops, firedBy
vars == <<tokenAt, armed, drops, firedBy>>

None == "none"

TypeState ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Drones
    /\ armed \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ drops \in 0..2
    /\ firedBy \in Drones \cup {None}

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = "g1"
    /\ armed = [d \in Drones |-> FALSE]
    /\ drops = 0
    /\ firedBy = None

Arm(d) ==
    /\ tokenAt = d
    /\ ~armed[d]
    /\ drops = 0
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, drops, firedBy>>

Disarm(d) ==
    /\ armed[d]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, drops, firedBy>>

Fire(d) ==
    /\ tokenAt = d
    /\ armed[d]
    /\ drops = 0
    /\ drops' = 1
    /\ firedBy' = d
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt>>

PassToken ==
    /\ \A d \in Drones : ~armed[d]
    /\ tokenAt' = (IF tokenAt = "g1" THEN "g2" ELSE "g1")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, drops, firedBy>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Arm(d) \/ Disarm(d) \/ Fire(d)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FireOnce ==
    /\ drops <= 1
    /\ ((drops = 1) <=> (firedBy # None))
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {"g1", "g2"}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FireOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm uses a token ring to grant exclusive authority to trigger a one-shot retardant drop, and two independent squads share one drop payload. The trigger token circulates around the ring; a drone may arm only when the token rests at its position, and it may fire the irreversible drop only while armed and holding the token. Once the drop has fired it is permanently spent and can never fire again. The token may be passed to the next position only when no drone is armed. The safety concern is that the irreversible retardant drop happens at most once across the entire shared payload.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the retardant drop fires at most once, and any drone that has fired did so while holding the ring token.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m5p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, Caps
VARIABLES votes, active, cap, phase
vars == <<votes, active, cap, phase>>

Yeses == Cardinality({d \in Drones : votes[d] = "yes"})

TypeState ==
    /\ votes \in [Drones -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ active \in 0..3
    /\ cap \in Caps
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "decided"}

Init ==
    /\ votes = [d \in Drones |-> "none"]
    /\ active = 0
    /\ cap = 2
    /\ phase = "voting"

Vote(d, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[d] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![d] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, cap, phase>>

Admit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Yeses >= 2
    /\ active < cap
    /\ active' = active + 1
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap>>

Reject ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A d \in Drones : votes[d] # "none"
    /\ Yeses < 2
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, cap>>

DropStream ==
    /\ active > 0
    /\ active' = active - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap, phase>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ votes' = [d \in Drones |-> "none"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, cap>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in Caps :
        /\ c >= active
        /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(d, v)
    \/ Admit \/ Reject \/ DropStream \/ ResetRound \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SwarmCapacity ==
    /\ active >= 0
    /\ active <= cap
====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm decides each new imaging assignment by quorum vote. To admit one more active image stream, a majority of the drones must vote yes in the current round, and the admission is allowed only while the number of active streams is below the configured bandwidth capacity. Votes are cast one drone at a time; once a decision (admit or reject) is reached the round resets and voting begins again. A drone may drop an active stream it holds, freeing bandwidth. Because atmospheric conditions vary, the operator can reconfigure the bandwidth capacity at runtime but never below the number of streams already active. The safety concern is that the number of active streams never exceeds the configured bandwidth capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of active image streams is always non-negative and never exceeds the configured bandwidth capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m9p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Caps
VARIABLES held, alive, epoch, cap
vars == <<held, alive, epoch, cap>>

Total == held["d1"] + held["d2"]

TypeState ==
    /\ held \in [Drones -> 0..3]
    /\ alive \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ epoch \in 0..2
    /\ cap \in Caps

Init ==
    /\ held = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ alive = [d \in Drones |-> TRUE]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ cap = 2

Accept(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ Total < cap
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = held[d] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, epoch, cap>>

Release(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ held[d] > 0
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = held[d] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, epoch, cap>>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ alive[d]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, epoch, cap>>

RotateEpoch ==
    /\ epoch < 2
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ held' = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ alive' = [d \in Drones |-> TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in Caps :
        /\ c >= Total
        /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, alive, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Accept(d) \/ Release(d) \/ Crash(d)
    \/ RotateEpoch \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FleetWithinCapacity ==
    /\ Total >= 0
    /\ Total <= cap
====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm accepts imaging tasks that occupy scarce onboard buffers, and the fleet operates in numbered epochs. Within an epoch each drone may accept a new task only while the total number of tasks held across the whole fleet is below the configured buffer capacity, and it may later release a task it holds. A drone can crash silently at any time, after which it simply stops accepting or releasing work but its already-held tasks remain counted until the next reconfiguration. When conditions change the operator rotates to a fresh epoch, which clears every drone's held tasks back to zero, and may separately reconfigure the buffer capacity but never below what is currently held. The safety concern is that the swarm as a whole must never hold more tasks than the buffer capacity allows.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of tasks held across all drones is always non-negative and never exceeds the configured buffer capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m4p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Engines, QCap
None == "none"
VARIABLES queue, book, matching, admin
vars == <<queue, book, matching, admin>>

TypeState ==
    /\ queue \in 0..QCap
    /\ book \in Engines \cup {None}
    /\ matching \in [Engines -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ queue = 0
    /\ book = None
    /\ matching = [e \in Engines |-> FALSE]
    /\ admin = FALSE

Enqueue ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ queue < QCap
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, matching, admin>>

Acquire(e) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ queue > 0
    /\ book = None
    /\ book' = e
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matching, admin>>

BeginMatch(e) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ book = e
    /\ ~matching[e]
    /\ matching' = [matching EXCEPT ![e] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, book, admin>>

EndMatch(e) ==
    /\ matching[e]
    /\ matching' = [matching EXCEPT ![e] = FALSE]
    /\ book' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, admin>>

AdminHalt ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ book' = None
    /\ matching' = [e \in Engines |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue>>

AdminResume ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, book, matching>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Acquire(e) \/ BeginMatch(e) \/ EndMatch(e)
    \/ AdminHalt \/ AdminResume

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuctionExclusion ==
    /\ (\A a, b \in Engines : (matching[a] /\ matching[b]) => a = b)
    /\ (\A e \in Engines : matching[e] => (book = e /\ ~admin))
    /\ (admin => book = None)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Engines = {e1, e2}
    QCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuctionExclusion
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction serializes match runs through a bounded work queue with backpressure so that only one matching engine mutates the order book at a time. Match jobs are enqueued only while the queue has room (backpressure), and an engine may begin matching only when it dequeues the head job and the book is free; it releases the book when the run completes. A privileged admin override can halt the auction, which forcibly frees the book and blocks any engine from matching until released. The safety concern is mutual exclusion of the order book: at most one engine matches at a time, and only an engine actively holding the book (with no admin halt) may be matching.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one matching engine holds the order book at any instant, and no engine is matching while the admin halt is active.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m3p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Ceilings
None == "none"
VARIABLES leader, term, myterm, dosed, ceiling
vars == <<leader, term, myterm, dosed, ceiling>>

TypeState ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..3
    /\ myterm \in [Nodes -> 0..3]
    /\ dosed \in 0..4
    /\ ceiling \in Ceilings

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ myterm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ dosed = 0
    /\ ceiling = 2

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term < 3
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ myterm' = [myterm EXCEPT ![n] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dosed, ceiling>>

StepDown(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, myterm, dosed, ceiling>>

Dispense(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ myterm[n] = term
    /\ dosed < ceiling
    /\ dosed' = dosed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, myterm, ceiling>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in Ceilings :
        /\ c >= dosed
        /\ ceiling' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, myterm, dosed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ StepDown(n) \/ Dispense(n)
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyLeaderDispenses ==
    /\ dosed <= ceiling
    /\ (leader # None => myterm[leader] = term)
====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser elects a leader controller with failover to authorize each medication release, and the daily dose ceiling can be reconfigured at runtime. Nodes contend for leadership; exactly one leader is active at a time and leadership passes to a standby only after the current leader steps down, advancing the term. Only the current leader may dispense a dose, and only while the running dose total is below the configured ceiling. A node that thinks it leads but is stale (its term is behind the current term) is barred from dispensing. The ceiling may be reconfigured but never below what has already been dispensed. The safety concern is that no dose is dispensed by an unauthorized or stale participant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every dispensed dose is authorized by the current leader whose term matches the current term, and the running dose total never exceeds the ceiling.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m3p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Capacity
None == "none"
VARIABLES leader, load, admin, term
vars == <<leader, load, admin, term>>

TypeState ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
    /\ load \in 0..Capacity
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN
    /\ term \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ load = 0
    /\ admin = FALSE
    /\ term = 0

Elect(n) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term < 3
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, admin>>

Failover(n) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, admin, term>>

Load(n) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ leader = n
    /\ load < Capacity
    /\ load' = load + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, admin, term>>

Unload ==
    /\ load > 0
    /\ load' = load - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, admin, term>>

AdminPause ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, term>>

AdminResume ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, load, term>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ Failover(n) \/ Load(n)
    \/ Unload \/ AdminPause \/ AdminResume

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarouselCapacity ==
    /\ load >= 0
    /\ load <= Capacity
    /\ (admin => leader = None)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Capacity = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarouselCapacity
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to a shared carousel under a leader-elected controller with failover. Nodes contend for leadership; exactly one leader is active, and leadership may fail over to a standby after the current leader steps down. Only the active leader may load a bag onto the carousel, and only while the carousel load is below its capacity. A privileged admin override can pause the whole carousel: while the override is active no leader may load, and the override forcibly clears leadership. The safety concern is that the carousel load never exceeds capacity, and no bag is loaded while the admin override is active.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the carousel load is always within capacity, and while the admin override is active there is no leader and no loading occurs.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m4p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, PoolSize
VARIABLES qlen, pushed, popped, running
vars == <<qlen, pushed, popped, running>>

Occ == qlen["a"] + qlen["b"]

TypeState ==
    /\ qlen \in [Instances -> 0..PoolSize]
    /\ pushed \in 0..9
    /\ popped \in 0..9
    /\ running \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ qlen = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ pushed = 0
    /\ popped = 0
    /\ running = [i \in Instances |-> TRUE]

Push(i) ==
    /\ running[i]
    /\ Occ < PoolSize
    /\ pushed < 9
    /\ qlen' = [qlen EXCEPT ![i] = qlen[i] + 1]
    /\ pushed' = pushed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<popped, running>>

Pop(i) ==
    /\ qlen[i] > 0
    /\ popped < 9
    /\ qlen' = [qlen EXCEPT ![i] = qlen[i] - 1]
    /\ popped' = popped + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pushed, running>>

Pause(i) ==
    /\ running[i]
    /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, pushed, popped>>

Resume(i) ==
    /\ ~running[i]
    /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, pushed, popped>>

Next == \E i \in Instances : Push(i) \/ Pop(i) \/ Pause(i) \/ Resume(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PoolBounded ==
    /\ Occ >= 0
    /\ Occ <= PoolSize
    /\ Occ = pushed - popped
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {"a", "b"}
    PoolSize = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PoolBounded
nl:
An airport baggage router feeds bags into a bounded work queue with backpressure, and two independent router instances share one physical conveyor pool. Either instance may push a bag into its queue only while the shared pool still has slack (total queued across both instances is below the shared pool size); this is the backpressure that stops overfilling. A downstream sorter pops a bag from either queue when that queue is non-empty. Each push and pop touches only the shared occupancy through the two per-instance queues. The safety concern is that the shared pool is bounded: the combined length of both instances' queues never exceeds the shared pool size.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of the two instances' queue lengths is always non-negative and never exceeds the shared conveyor pool size.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m0p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Clients, MaxVer
VARIABLES version, value, snap, mode
vars == <<version, value, snap, mode>>

TypeState ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ value \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Clients -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ mode \in [Clients -> {"idle", "reading"}]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ value = 0
    /\ snap = [c \in Clients |-> 0]
    /\ mode = [c \in Clients |-> "idle"]

Read(c) ==
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "reading"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ mode[c] = "reading"
    /\ snap[c] = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ value' = value + 1
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap>>

Conflict(c) ==
    /\ mode[c] = "reading"
    /\ snap[c] # version
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value, snap>>

Idle(c) ==
    /\ mode[c] = "idle"
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value, snap>>

Next == \E c \in Clients : Read(c) \/ Commit(c) \/ Conflict(c) \/ Idle(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ value = version
    /\ (\A c \in Clients : snap[c] <= version)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Clients = {c1, c2}
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network keeps a shared policy record that clients update with optimistic locking. Each client first reads the record's current version into a local snapshot, prepares a change, and then attempts to commit; the commit succeeds only if the record's version still matches the snapshot the client read, in which case the record's value and version both advance. If some other client committed in between, the version no longer matches and the client must abandon and re-read (retry) rather than overwrite. A client that is merely slow keeps a stale snapshot but is never dropped. The safety concern is that no committed update is ever silently lost: the record version only advances, and it never advances by a commit built on a stale snapshot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the record version never decreases, and every client holding a snapshot older than the record is blocked from committing until it re-reads.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m0p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Locks, Supply
VARIABLES free, pocket, admin, retries
vars == <<free, pocket, admin, retries>>

Held == pocket["l1"] + pocket["l2"]

TypeState ==
    /\ free \in 0..Supply
    /\ pocket \in [Locks -> 0..Supply]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retries \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ free = Supply
    /\ pocket = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ admin = FALSE
    /\ retries = 0

Claim(l) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ free > 0
    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ pocket' = [pocket EXCEPT ![l] = pocket[l] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<admin, retries>>

Retry(l) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ free = 0
    /\ retries < 3
    /\ retries' = retries + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, pocket, admin>>

Return(l) ==
    /\ pocket[l] > 0
    /\ pocket' = [pocket EXCEPT ![l] = pocket[l] - 1]
    /\ free' = free + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<admin, retries>>

AdminRecall ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ free' = Supply
    /\ pocket' = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<retries>>

AdminClear ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, pocket, retries>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Claim(l) \/ Retry(l) \/ Return(l)
    \/ AdminRecall \/ AdminClear

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TokenConservation ==
    free + Held = Supply
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Locks = {"l1", "l2"}
    Supply = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokenConservation
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network manages a fixed pool of access tokens that circulate between the locks and a central hub. Each lock optimistically claims a token by reading the hub's free pool and, if it still has room, moving one token into its own pocket; because claims are optimistic they can be retried after a conflict rather than blocking. A lock later returns a token to the hub. A privileged admin override can recall every outstanding token back to the hub in one step. Tokens are neither minted nor discarded during normal operation: every token is always either free at the hub or held by exactly one lock. The safety concern is conservation of the token pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of free tokens at the hub plus the tokens held across all locks always equals the fixed total token supply.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m9p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Patrons, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, ledger, stamp, alive
vars == <<epoch, ledger, stamp, alive>>

TypeState ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ ledger \in 0..5
    /\ stamp \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxEpoch \cup {-1}]
    /\ alive \in [Patrons -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ stamp = [p \in Patrons |-> -1]
    /\ alive = [p \in Patrons |-> TRUE]

Sync(p) ==
    /\ alive[p]
    /\ stamp[p] = -1
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, ledger, alive>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ alive[p]
    /\ stamp[p] = epoch
    /\ ledger < 5
    /\ ledger' = ledger + 1
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, alive>>

RejectStale(p) ==
    /\ stamp[p] # -1
    /\ stamp[p] # epoch
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, ledger, alive>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ alive[p]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, ledger, stamp>>

Rotate ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, stamp, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Sync(p) \/ Commit(p) \/ RejectStale(p) \/ Crash(p)
    \/ Rotate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LedgerMonotone ==
    /\ ledger >= 0
    /\ (\A p \in Patrons : stamp[p] # -1 => stamp[p] <= epoch)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LedgerMonotone
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A library book reservation system replicates a shared reservation ledger across epochs, and only writes carrying the current epoch may be committed. Patrons submit reservation commits stamped with the epoch they last synced; a commit advances the ledger's committed count only if its stamp matches the current epoch, so a commit from a patron who synced in an older epoch is rejected rather than applied. One patron node can crash silently, after which it submits nothing further, but the ledger it already committed to stays intact. When the system reconfigures it rotates to a fresh epoch, invalidating any not-yet-committed stale writes. The safety concern is that no committed reservation is lost: the ledger count never regresses and no stale-epoch commit is ever applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the ledger's committed count never decreases, and it is only ever advanced by a commit whose epoch stamp matched the current epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m9p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Members, Slots, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES holds, epoch, readEp, alive
vars == <<holds, epoch, readEp, alive>>

SlotHeld(s) == \E m \in Members : <<m, s>> \in holds

TypeState ==
    /\ holds \subseteq (Members \X Slots)
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ readEp \in [Members -> 0..MaxEpoch \cup {-1}]
    /\ alive \in [Members -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ holds = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ readEp = [m \in Members |-> -1]
    /\ alive = [m \in Members |-> TRUE]

Read(m) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ readEp' = [readEp EXCEPT ![m] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, epoch, alive>>

Claim(m, s) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ readEp[m] = epoch
    /\ ~SlotHeld(s)
    /\ holds' = holds \cup {<<m, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, readEp, alive>>

RefuseStale(m) ==
    /\ readEp[m] # -1
    /\ readEp[m] # epoch
    /\ readEp' = [readEp EXCEPT ![m] = -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, epoch, alive>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, epoch, readEp>>

Rotate ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ holds' = {}
    /\ readEp' = [m \in Members |-> -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : Read(m) \/ RefuseStale(m) \/ Crash(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members, s \in Slots : Claim(m, s)
    \/ Rotate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SlotUnique ==
    /\ (\A m \in Members : readEp[m] # -1 => readEp[m] <= epoch)
    /\ (\A a, b \in Members, s \in Slots :
            (<<a, s>> \in holds /\ <<b, s>> \in holds) => a = b)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Members = {m1, m2}
    Slots = {sa, sb}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SlotUnique
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch assigns each settlement slot in a batch to at most one member bank, and processing proceeds in numbered epochs. Ownership is recorded as a set of member-slot holdings. A member claims a settlement slot only when no member currently holds that slot and the member's read epoch matches the batch's current epoch; a stale claim (from an old epoch) is refused. One member bank can crash silently and thereafter makes no further claims, though the holdings it already has remain until the batch epoch rotates. Rotating to a new epoch clears every holding so the next batch starts fresh. The safety concern is that within a batch no settlement slot is ever double-allocated to two different member banks.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each settlement slot is held by at most one member bank at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m5p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Stations
VARIABLES votes, setting, revision, phase, admin
vars == <<votes, setting, revision, phase, admin>>

Yeses == Cardinality({s \in Stations : votes[s] = "yes"})

TypeState ==
    /\ votes \in [Stations -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ setting \in 0..4
    /\ revision \in 0..4
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "decided"}
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ votes = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ setting = 0
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ admin = FALSE

Vote(s, v) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<setting, revision, phase, admin>>

Apply ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Yeses >= 2
    /\ revision < 4
    /\ setting' = revision + 1
    /\ revision' = revision + 1
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, admin>>

Discard ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A s \in Stations : votes[s] # "none"
    /\ Yeses < 2
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, setting, revision, admin>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ votes' = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<setting, revision, admin>>

AdminForce ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ revision < 4
    /\ setting' = revision + 1
    /\ revision' = revision + 1
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, phase>>

AdminClear ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, setting, revision, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(s, v)
    \/ Apply \/ Discard \/ ResetRound \/ AdminForce \/ AdminClear

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SettingConsistent ==
    /\ setting = revision
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Stations = {s1, s2, s3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SettingConsistent
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line adjusts a shared wash-program setting through quorum voting so that partial or conflicting reconfigurations never take effect. To change the setting to a new value, a majority of the station controllers must first vote yes for that proposal in the current round; only then is the setting committed and its revision advanced. Votes are cast one controller at a time and the round resets after each decision. A privileged admin override can force the setting to a safe default at any time, advancing the revision as well. The safety concern is that the committed setting's revision only ever moves forward and never regresses, so no earlier update is lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the wash-program revision never decreases, and the committed setting always equals the value of the most recently applied revision.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m5p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Shards
VARIABLES votes, revision, published, phase
vars == <<votes, revision, published, phase>>

Yeses == Cardinality({s \in Shards : votes[s] = "yes"})

TypeState ==
    /\ votes \in [Shards -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ revision \in 0..4
    /\ published \in 0..4
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "decided"}

Init ==
    /\ votes = [s \in Shards |-> "none"]
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ published = 0
    /\ phase = "voting"

Vote(s, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, published, phase>>

Publish ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Yeses >= 2
    /\ revision < 4
    /\ revision' = revision + 1
    /\ published' = revision + 1
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes>>

Reject ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A s \in Shards : votes[s] # "none"
    /\ Yeses < 2
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, revision, published>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ votes' = [s \in Shards |-> "none"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revision, published>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Shards : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(s, v)
    \/ Publish \/ Reject \/ ResetRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RosterConsistent ==
    /\ published = revision
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Shards = {s1, s2, s3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RosterConsistent
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker maintains a shared match roster revision that two independent lobby instances share via quorum voting. To publish a new roster, a majority of the voting shards must approve the current proposal round; only then does the roster revision advance and the published roster equal the new revision. Votes are cast one shard at a time, and after each decision the round resets. Because the two instances draw from the same pool of shards, a proposal is committed only once per revision, preventing a lost update where a later publish silently discards an earlier one. The safety concern is that the roster revision only moves forward and the published roster always matches the latest committed revision.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the roster revision never decreases and the published roster value always equals the current roster revision.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m9p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Players, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, seated, reqs, seatEp
vars == <<epoch, seated, reqs, seatEp>>

TypeState ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ seated \in [Players -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ reqs \subseteq (Players \X (0..MaxEpoch))
    /\ seatEp \in [Players -> 0..MaxEpoch \cup {-1}]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ seated = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ seatEp = [p \in Players |-> -1]

Join(p) ==
    /\ ~seated[p]
    /\ <<p, epoch>> \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {<<p, epoch>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seated, seatEp>>

Seat(p, e) ==
    /\ <<p, e>> \in reqs
    /\ e = epoch
    /\ ~seated[p]
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ seatEp' = [seatEp EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<p, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch>>

DropStale(p, e) ==
    /\ <<p, e>> \in reqs
    /\ e # epoch
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<p, e>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seated, seatEp>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ seated' = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ seatEp' = [p \in Players |-> -1]
    /\ reqs' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Join(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players, e \in (0..MaxEpoch) : Seat(p, e) \/ DropStale(p, e)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyCurrentSeats ==
    /\ (\A p \in Players : seated[p] => seatEp[p] = epoch)
    /\ (\A tup \in reqs : tup[2] <= epoch)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyCurrentSeats
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into a match through epoch-numbered reconfiguration over a channel where join messages can be reordered. Players post join requests into a request set that the matchmaker consumes in any order (reordering), each request carrying the epoch the player last observed. The matchmaker seats a player only if the request's epoch matches the current lobby epoch, so a request observed under an old epoch is dropped rather than seated. When the lobby reconfigures it advances the epoch and clears all seats and pending requests, so stale joins cannot leak across. The safety concern is that no player is seated by a stale or unauthorized (wrong-epoch) request: every seated player was seated under the current epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every seated player was seated under a request whose epoch matched the lobby's current epoch, and any pending request carries an epoch not ahead of the current epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m0p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cabs, Floors
None == "none"
VARIABLES claim, inservice, retries, serviced
vars == <<claim, inservice, retries, serviced>>

TypeState ==
    /\ claim \in [Floors -> Cabs \cup {None}]
    /\ inservice \in [Cabs -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ retries \in 0..3
    /\ serviced \in 0..4

Init ==
    /\ claim = [f \in Floors |-> None]
    /\ inservice = [c \in Cabs |-> TRUE]
    /\ retries = 0
    /\ serviced = 0

Claim(c, f) ==
    /\ inservice[c]
    /\ claim[f] = None
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![f] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inservice, retries, serviced>>

Retry(c, f) ==
    /\ inservice[c]
    /\ claim[f] # None
    /\ claim[f] # c
    /\ retries < 3
    /\ retries' = retries + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, inservice, serviced>>

Service(c, f) ==
    /\ claim[f] = c
    /\ serviced < 4
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![f] = None]
    /\ serviced' = serviced + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inservice, retries>>

TakeOut(c) ==
    /\ inservice[c]
    /\ \A f \in Floors : claim[f] # c
    /\ inservice' = [inservice EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, retries, serviced>>

BringIn(c) ==
    /\ ~inservice[c]
    /\ inservice' = [inservice EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, retries, serviced>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cabs, f \in Floors : Claim(c, f) \/ Retry(c, f) \/ Service(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Cabs : TakeOut(c) \/ BringIn(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FloorUnique ==
    /\ (\A f \in Floors : claim[f] # None => inservice[claim[f]])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cabs = {c1, c2}
    Floors = {f1, f2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FloorUnique
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper assigns each pending hall call to at most one cab using optimistic locking with retry, and the number of cabs in service can change at runtime. A cab optimistically claims a hall-call floor by checking that the floor is currently unclaimed and, if so, tagging it with the cab's id; if two cabs race, the loser sees the floor already tagged and retries elsewhere. A cab clears its claim once it has serviced the floor. Cabs can be brought into or taken out of service at runtime, changing how many can claim, but an out-of-service cab holds no claims. The safety concern is that a floor is never double-allocated: no floor is claimed by two different cabs at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each hall-call floor is claimed by at most one cab at any time, and any claim belongs to an in-service cab.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m2p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cabs, Caps
VARIABLES votes, decision, load, cap, phase
vars == <<votes, decision, load, cap, phase>>

TypeState ==
    /\ votes \in [Cabs -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ decision \in {"none", "commit", "abort"}
    /\ load \in 0..3
    /\ cap \in Caps
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "decided"}

Init ==
    /\ votes = [c \in Cabs |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ load = 0
    /\ cap = 2
    /\ phase = "voting"

CastYes(c) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[c] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, load, cap, phase>>

CastNo(c) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[c] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = "no"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, load, cap, phase>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A c \in Cabs : votes[c] = "yes"
    /\ load < cap
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ load' = load + 1
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E c \in Cabs : votes[c] = "no"
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, load, cap>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ votes' = [c \in Cabs |-> "none"]
    /\ decision' = "none"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in Caps :
        /\ c >= load
        /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, decision, load, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cabs : CastYes(c) \/ CastNo(c)
    \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ ResetRound \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    /\ load >= 0
    /\ load <= cap
    /\ (phase = "decided" /\ decision = "commit" => load >= 1)
====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper dispatches riders to cabs through a two-phase commit. When a new rider request arrives, each cab casts a vote (yes if it can take the rider, no otherwise) while the dispatch coordinator is in its voting phase. If every cab votes yes and the shared hall load is still below the current capacity, the coordinator commits, admitting one more rider into service and moving to a decided phase; if any cab votes no, it aborts. After a decision the round resets and voting reopens. Because express service can be toggled, an operator may reconfigure the capacity up or down at runtime, but never below the load already in service. The safety concern is that the number of riders in service must never exceed the currently configured capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the in-service rider load is always non-negative and never exceeds the capacity configured at that moment.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m8p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cranes
None == "none"
VARIABLES bay, beam, hoisting, admin
vars == <<bay, beam, hoisting, admin>>

TypeState ==
    /\ bay \in Cranes \cup {None}
    /\ beam \in Cranes \cup {None}
    /\ hoisting \in [Cranes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ bay = None
    /\ beam = None
    /\ hoisting = [c \in Cranes |-> FALSE]
    /\ admin = FALSE

TakeBay(c) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ bay = None
    /\ bay' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<beam, hoisting, admin>>

TakeBeam(c) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ bay = c
    /\ beam = None
    /\ beam' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, hoisting, admin>>

Hoist(c) ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ bay = c
    /\ beam = c
    /\ ~hoisting[c]
    /\ hoisting' = [hoisting EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, beam, admin>>

Lower(c) ==
    /\ hoisting[c]
    /\ hoisting' = [hoisting EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, beam, admin>>

ReleaseBeam(c) ==
    /\ beam = c
    /\ ~hoisting[c]
    /\ beam' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, hoisting, admin>>

ReleaseBay(c) ==
    /\ bay = c
    /\ beam # c
    /\ bay' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<beam, hoisting, admin>>

AdminSeize ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ bay' = None
    /\ beam' = None
    /\ hoisting' = [c \in Cranes |-> FALSE]

AdminRelease ==
    /\ admin
    /\ admin' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, beam, hoisting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : TakeBay(c) \/ TakeBeam(c) \/ Hoist(c) \/ Lower(c)
                          \/ ReleaseBeam(c) \/ ReleaseBay(c)
    \/ AdminSeize \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CraneExclusion ==
    /\ (admin => (bay = None /\ beam = None))
    /\ (\A c \in Cranes : hoisting[c] => (bay = c /\ beam = c /\ ~admin))
    /\ (\A a, b \in Cranes : (hoisting[a] /\ hoisting[b]) => a = b)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {k1, k2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CraneExclusion
nl:
A container-ship crane yard protects a single spreader beam with hierarchical locks: a crane must first take the coarse bay lock, then the fine beam lock, and only then may it hoist. Locks are always released in reverse order (beam before bay). A privileged admin override can seize control for maintenance, which forcibly frees both locks and blocks all cranes until the override is released. The safety concern is that the spreader beam is mutually exclusive: at most one crane hoists at a time, and any crane hoisting must hold both the bay and beam locks and must not be under an active admin override.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one crane is hoisting at any instant, and a hoisting crane holds both the bay and beam locks with no admin override active.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m3p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Ceilings
None == "none"
VARIABLES leader, term, committed, ceiling, myterm
vars == <<leader, term, committed, ceiling, myterm>>

TypeState ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..3
    /\ committed \in 0..3
    /\ ceiling \in Ceilings
    /\ myterm \in [Nodes -> 0..3]

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ committed = 0
    /\ ceiling = 2
    /\ myterm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term < 3
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ myterm' = [myterm EXCEPT ![n] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, ceiling>>

StepDown(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, committed, ceiling, myterm>>

Append(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ myterm[n] = term
    /\ committed < ceiling
    /\ committed' = committed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, ceiling, myterm>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in Ceilings :
        /\ c >= committed
        /\ ceiling' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, committed, myterm>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ StepDown(n) \/ Append(n)
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ShedLogConsistent ==
    /\ committed <= ceiling
    /\ (leader # None => myterm[leader] = term)
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder elects a leader controller that owns a shared shed-log recording how much load has been shed. Nodes contest to become leader; exactly one leader is active at a time, and a leader can fail over so that leadership passes to another node only after the old leader steps down. Only the current leader may append a shed decision, which advances the shed-log's committed count and its version together. A node that believes it is leader but is stale (its recorded term is behind the current term) is barred from appending, preventing a lost update to the log. Because grid conditions shift, the shed ceiling can be reconfigured at runtime but never below what has already been committed. The safety concern is that no leader's append is lost or overwritten by a stale one.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shed-log committed count equals its version, never exceeds the current ceiling, and only a leader whose term matches the current term may have advanced it.
